40003223.author: पदार्थः
40003223.content: रामे when Rama, इति like this, ब्रुवति was speaking, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmana, अधश्शिरा: with his head down, मनसा in his mind, मुहुः repeatedly, दुःखहर्षयो: in grief and joy, मध्यम् midway, जगामेव as if entered.

40003223.author: Translation
40003223.content: While Rama was speaking thus, Lakshmana listened to him with his head down, experiencing both grief and joy.

40003224.author: पदार्थः
40003224.content: नरर्षभः best  among men (Lakshmana), तदा तु then, भ्रुवो: brows, मध्ये in between, भ्रुकुटीम्   a frown, बध्द्वा having knitted, बिलस्थः in its hole, रोषितः seized with anger, महासर्पः great serpent, इव like, निशश्वास hissed.

40003224.author: Translation
40003224.content: Lakshmana, frowning between his eyebrows, hissed like a great serpent seized with anger in its hole.

40003225.author: पदार्थः
40003225.content: तदा then, दुष्प्रतिवीक्षम् frightening to look at, भ्रुकुटी सहितम् with frown, तत् that, तस्य his, मुखम् face, क्रुद्धस्य of angry ones, सिंहस्य of a lion, सदृशम् similar, बभौ shone.

40003225.author: Translation
40003225.content: With his frown, his face looked frightening like the face of a lion provoked.

40003226.author: पदार्थः
40003226.content: हस्ती elephant, आत्मनः its own, हस्तम् इव like its trunk, अग्रहस्तम् forearm, विधुन्वन् shaking, शिरोधराम् neck, शरीरे in the body, तिर्यक् horizontally, ऊर्ध्वंच upward, पातयित्वा casting, अग्राक्ष्णा with pointed look, भ्रातरम् to brother, तिर्यक् obliquely, वीक्षमाणः looking, अब्रवीत् said.

40003226.author: Translation
40003226.content: Shaking his forearm like an elephant raising its trunk, moving his neck horizontally and vertically and casting a pointed and oblique look at his brother, Lakshmana said:

40003227.author: पदार्थः
40003227.content: शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ great among brave kshatriyas, यस्य whose, धर्मदोषप्रसङ्गेन (your) stand that harm will be done to  righteousness, लोकस्य of the world, अनतिशङ्कया apprehending verdict in favour of exile, अस्थाने at improper time, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सम्भ्रमः haste, जातः वै was born, त्वद्विधः men such as you are, असम्भ्रान्तः without apprehension, अशौण्डीरम् devoid of strength, दैवम् destiny, यथा as, एतत् all this, कथम् how, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हति is fit for you.

40003227.author: Translation
40003227.content: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehension about people's verdict (in favour of exile). How do you, of all persons, speak about destiny as allpowerful in these circumstances when it is powerless?

40003228.author: पदार्थः
40003228.content: शौण्डीर क्षत्रियर्षभ great among brave kshatriyas, यस्य whose, धर्मदोषप्रसङ्गेन (your) stand that harm will be done to  righteousness, लोकस्य of the world, अनतिशङ्कया apprehending verdict in favour of exile, अस्थाने at improper time, अयम् this, सुमहान् great, सम्भ्रमः haste, जातः वै was born, त्वद्विधः men such as you are, असम्भ्रान्तः without apprehension, अशौण्डीरम् devoid of strength, दैवम् destiny, यथा as, एतत् all this, कथम् how, वक्तुम् to tell, अर्हति is fit for you.

40003228.author: Translation
40003228.content: O Rama, the greatest among the brave kshatriyas you say this because of your fear that (by disobeying father's command) harm will be done to righteousness. This great haste is unwarranted for there is the least apprehension about people's verdict (in favour of exile). How do you, of all persons, speak about destiny as allpowerful in these circumstances when it is powerless?

40003229.author: पदार्थः
40003229.content: कृपणम् pitiable, अशक्तम् powerless, दैवम् destiny, किम् नाम what for, अभिशंससि you are extoling, पापयोः of two vicious people, तयोः of both of them, ते to you, शङ्का apprehension, कथं नाम how, न विद्यते does not arise.

40003229.author: Translation
40003229.content: Why do you extol this pitiable and powerless destiny? Why don't you doubt those two vicious persons (Dasaratha and Kaikeyi)?

40003230.author: पदार्थः
40003230.content: धर्मात्मन् O virtuous one, शाठ्यात् perfidiously, स्वार्थम् for selfish ends, सुचरितम् of good conduct, परिजिहीर्षतोः for both of them repudiating, तयोः of both of them, श्लक्ष्णाः soft ones, धर्मोपधा acts of deception in the guise of righteousness, सन्ति exist, किं why, न बुध्यसे do you not know.

40003230.author: Translation
40003230.content: Why don't you realise, O virtuous one that there are soft means of creating hindrances in their plan without trangressing dharma. You know dharma. Why don't you understand that their acts of deception wear the guise of dharma?

40003231.author: पदार्थः
40003231.content: राघव O Rama, प्रागेव even before, तयोः their own, व्यवसितम् decision, एवम् in this way, न स्याद्धि if it was not like that, प्रकृतः by nature, सः that, वरः boon, प्रागेव दत्तः स्यात् would have been given long before.

40003231.author: Translation
40003231.content: If both of them had not decided before, O Rama the boon granted to Kaikeyi naturally would have been fulfilled long ago.

40003232.author: पदार्थः
40003232.content: वीर O valiant one, लोकविद्विष्टम् universally detested, आरब्धम् commenced, त्वदन्यस्य any one other than you, अभिषेचनम् consecration, सहितुम् to tolerate, नोत्सहे I do not desire, तत्र in this matter, मे to me, क्षन्तुम् pardon, अर्हसि it behoves you.

40003232.author: Translation
40003232.content: The consecration of any one other than you, O valiant one is universally detested. I do not want to tolerate (this act). You should pardon me in this matter.

40003233.author: पदार्थः
40003233.content: महामते O nobleminded one, येन by which, तव your, (इदम् this), बुद्धि: intellect, द्वैधम् dilemma, आगता attained, यस्य whose, प्रसङ्गात् concern, मुह्यसि you are deluded, सः धर्मः that righteousness, मम to me, द्वेष्यः deserve to be hated.

40003233.author: Translation
40003233.content: O noble minded one I hate this righteousness which has deluded your intellect and created this dilemma about this issue.

40003234.author: पदार्थः
40003234.content: कर्मणा by your act, शक्तः being powerful, त्वम् you, कैकेयीवशवर्तिनः who is under the influence of Kaikeyi, पितुः father's, अधर्मिष्ठम् unjustifiable, विगर्हितम् contemptible, वाक्यम् words, कथम् how, करिष्यसि can you carry out?

40003234.author: Translation
40003234.content: When you are able to counter (this move), why do you want to execute the unjustifiable and contemptible words of the king who is under the spell of Kaikeyi?

40003235.author: पदार्थः
40003235.content: अयम् this, भेदः treachery, किल्बिषात् out of guilty mind, कृतोऽपि even done, एवम् in this way, न गृह्यते यदि is not taken in its right sense, तत्र in that matter, मे to me, दुःखम् grief, जायते is arising, धर्मसङ्गश्च attachment to virtue, गर्हितः is censurable.

40003235.author: Translation
40003235.content: I am grieved that even though this plot has been hatched by a treacherous mind, you are not taking it in the right perspective. Censurable is adherence to virtue.

40003236.author: पदार्थः
40003236.content: कामवृत्तयोः of both steeped in passion, नित्यम् always, अहितयोः of both hostile, पित्रभिधानयोः known as parents, शत्र्वोः enemies, कामम् passion, त्वम् you, मनसा अपि even in mind, कथम् how, कुर्याः will you carry out?

40003236.author: Translation
40003236.content: As both of them are steeped in passion, they never thought of your wellbeing. How will you fulfil the wishes of these enemies miscalled parents?

40003237.author: पदार्थः
40003237.content: तयोः of both of them, प्रतिपत्ति: dictates, दैवी च is the decree of destiny, ते your, मतं यद्यपि even if it is your opinion, तथापि even then, तदपि that one also, ते to you, उपेक्षणीयम् should be ignored, न रोचते it does not please me.

40003237.author: Translation
40003237.content: It might be your opinion that their dictate is the decree of destiny. Even then, it does not satisfy me. It (destiny) should be ignored.

40003238.author: पदार्थः
40003238.content: यः who, विक्लबः timid, वीर्यहीनः weak, सः that one, दैवम् the destiny, अनुवर्तते follows, सम्भावितात्मानः respected souls, वीराः the valiant, दैवम् destiny, न पर्युपासते do not depend upon.

40003238.author: Translation
40003238.content: Those who are timid and cowardly alone depend on destiny.The valiant with of selfrespect will not accept it.

40003239.author: पदार्थः
40003239.content: यः पुरुषः such a  man, पुरुषकारेण with human effort, दैवम् destiny, प्रबाधितुम् to strike,  समर्थः is capable, सः he, दैवेन by destiny, विपन्नार्थः with defeated objectives, न अवसीदति will not grieve.

40003239.author: Translation
40003239.content: In the case of one capable of striking destiny with human efforts it cannot defeat his objective and bring him despondency.

40003240.author: पदार्थः
40003240.content: अद्य today, दैवस्य destiny's, पुरुषस्य च also man's, पौरुषम् power, द्रक्ष्यन्ति will see, अद्य today, दैवमानुषयोः of destiny and man, व्यक्तिः difference, व्यक्ता will manifest, भविष्यति will become.

40003240.author: Translation
40003240.content: Today all will witness the power of destiny and the power of man. The difference between man and destiny will be manifested today.

40003241.author: पदार्थः
40003241.content: अद्य today, ते your, राज्याभिषेचनम् installation as heirapparent, यद्दैवात् by which divinity, आहतम् as prevented, दृष्टम् has been seen, दैवम् destiny, अद्य today, जनाः people, मत्पौरुषहतम् defeated by my valour, द्रक्ष्यन्ति वै shall witness.

40003241.author: Translation
40003241.content: Today people will see destiny defeated by my valour just as they saw your consecration defeated (obstructed) by destiny.

40003242.author: पदार्थः
40003242.content: अहम् I, अत्यङ्कुशम् unmanageable by the goad, उद्दामम् unrestrained, मदबलोद्धतम् uncontrollable through the strongth of nut, प्रधावितम् running away, गजम् इव like an elephant, दैवम् destiny, पौरुषेण with valour, निवर्तये I will turn back.

40003242.author: Translation
40003242.content: I will make destiny, the elephant, running wild on the strength of the rut, unmanageable (even) by the goad, turn back with my valour.

40003243.author: पदार्थः
40003243.content: अद्य today, ते those, समस्ताः all, लोकपालाः guardians of the quarters, रामाभिषेचनम् consecration of Rama, न विहन्युः cannot obstruct, कृत्स्नाः all, त्रयः लोकाः च the three worlds, न cannot, पिता father, किं पुनः needless to say again.

40003243.author: Translation
40003243.content: All the guardians of the quarters and all the three worlds united cannot prevent the consecration of Rama today, what to speak of our father (king Dasaratha).

40003244.author: पदार्थः
40003244.content: राजन् O king, यैः by whom, अरण्ये in the forest, तव your, निवासः live, मिथः mutual, समर्थितः support, ते they, तथा in the same way, चतुर्दश समाः fourteen years, अरण्ये in the forest, निवत्स्यन्ति they shall reside.

40003244.author: Translation
40003244.content: O king those who, with mutual support banished you to the forest, will themselves  dwell in the forest for fourteen years.

40003245.author: पदार्थः
40003245.content: तत् for that reason, अहम् I, पितुः father's, या Kaikeyi, तव your, अभिषेकविघातेन by obstructing your consecration, पुत्रराज्याय the kingdom for her son, वर्तते is intending, तस्याश्च her, आशाम् desire, छेत्स्यामि I will break asunder.

40003245.author: Translation
40003245.content: Therefore, I shall frustrate the desire of father and of  Kaikeyi who plans the kingdom for her son by obstructing your consecration.

40003246.author: पदार्थः
40003246.content: मद्बलेन with my valour, विरुद्धाय any one who opposes, उग्रम् terrible, मम पौरुषम् my valour, यथा how, दुःखाय for sorrow, प्रभविष्यति will result, तथा like that, दैव बलम् the power  of destiny, न स्यात् may not be.

40003246.author: Translation
40003246.content: Any one who opposes my terrible valour will come to grief. The power of destiny will not cause that much sorrow as my valour will.

40003247.author: पदार्थः
40003247.content: प्रजापाल्यमनन्तरं afte ruling the subjects, वर्ष सहस्रान्ते after a thousand years, त्वयि you, वनवासं गते after you have withdrawn to the forest, आर्यपुत्राः your sons, करिष्यन्ति will rule them.

40003247.author: Translation
40003247.content: When after ruling the subjects for a thousand years you withdraw into the forest (for yativrata) your sons will rule them.

40003248.author: पदार्थः
40003248.content: पुत्रेषु in sons, प्रजाः subjects, पुत्रवत् like sons, परिपालने in ruling, निक्षिप्य after entrusting, वनवासः retiring into the forest, पूर्वं राजर्षिवृत्त्या as rajarsis did in ancient times, विधीयते हि is established.

40003248.author: Translation
40003248.content: Leaving their sons to look after the subjects as their own children, the rajarsis in  ancient times used to retire into the forest as per practice.

40003249.author: पदार्थः
40003249.content: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, राम Rama, राजनि when the king, अनेकाग्रे in many directions (and unable to decide), राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया with apprehension that disturbances  in the kingdom will arise, सः त्वम् such you, एवम् in this way, राज्यम् kingdom, आत्मनि to you, न इच्छसि चेत् if it is not desired, ते to you, प्रतिजाने च I am swearing, वीर O valient one, वीरलोकभाक् attaining the afterworld of heroes, माऽभूवम् let it not be my fate, अहम् I, वेला shore, सागरम् इव like ocean, तव your, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षेयम् I will protect.

40003249.author: Translation
40003249.content: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the ocean. Or else, I shall never attain the afterworld of heroes.

40003250.author: पदार्थः
40003250.content: धर्मात्मन् O righteous one, राम Rama, राजनि when the king, अनेकाग्रे in many directions (and unable to decide), राज्यविभ्रमशङ्कया with apprehension that disturbances  in the kingdom will arise, सः त्वम् such you, एवम् in this way, राज्यम् kingdom, आत्मनि to you, न इच्छसि चेत् if it is not desired, ते to you, प्रतिजाने च I am swearing, वीर O valient one, वीरलोकभाक् attaining the afterworld of heroes, माऽभूवम् let it not be my fate, अहम् I, वेला shore, सागरम् इव like ocean, तव your, राज्यम् kingdom, रक्षेयम् I will protect.

40003250.author: Translation
40003250.content: O righteous one, if you apprehend chaos in the kingdom for want of wholehearted support from the (feudatory) kings then, O my valiant brother, I swear to you, I will protect your kingdom like the shore protecting the ocean. Or else, I shall never attain the afterworld of heroes.

40003251.author: पदार्थः
40003251.content: त्वम् you, मङ्गलैः with auspicious materials, अभिषिञ्चस्व you may continue the consecration ceremony, तत्र in this matter, व्यापृतः getting engaged in, भव become, अहम् I, एकः singlehanded, बलात् by my valour, महीपालान् the kings, वारयितुम् to prevent, अलम् am competent.

40003251.author: Translation
40003251.content: The consecration may be performed with these auspicious materials. I am alone capable of facing these kings with my valour.

40003252.author: पदार्थः
40003252.content: इमौ this, मे बाहू my two arms, शोभार्थौ for purposes of enhancing beauty, न not, धनुः bow, भूषणाय for decorating, न not, असिः sword, आबन्धनार्थाय for fastening on my waist, न not, शराः arrows, स्तम्भहेतवः remain fixed, न not, मे my, सर्वम् all this, एतत् this, चतुष्टयम् four weapons, अमित्रदमनार्थम् only for subduing enemies.

40003252.author: Translation
40003252.content: These my arms are not intended to enhance the beauty (of my body). This bow is not for decoration. The sword is not for the sake of strapping my waist. The arrows are not meant to be fixed to my quiver. All these four are meant for taming my enemies.

40003253.author: पदार्थः
40003253.content: अहम् I, यः who, मम my, शत्रुः as enemy, मतः स्यात् is considered, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, न कामये I do not desire (to endure), तीक्ष्णधारेण with a sharpedged, विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा with the  lustre of flashing lightning, प्रगृहीतेन by holding, असिना with sword, शत्रुम् to the enemy, वज्रिणं वा or Indra, (bearer of thunder), न कल्पये will not spare.

40003253.author: Translation
40003253.content: Any one who turns my enemy will not be allowed to remain alive. Holding my sharpedged sword, lustrous as a flash of lightning, I shall  exterminate my enemy even if it were Indra, the bearer of thunder.

40003254.author: पदार्थः
40003254.content: अहम् I, यः who, मम my, शत्रुः as enemy, मतः स्यात् is considered, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, न कामये I do not desire (to endure), तीक्ष्णधारेण with a sharpedged, विद्युच्चलितवर्चसा with the  lustre of flashing lightning, प्रगृहीतेन by holding, असिना with sword, शत्रुम् to the enemy, वज्रिणं वा or Indra, (bearer of thunder), न कल्पये will not spare.

40003254.author: Translation
40003254.content: Any one who turns my enemy will not be allowed to remain alive. Holding my sharpedged sword, lustrous as a flash of lightning, I shall  exterminate my enemy even if it were Indra, the bearer of thunder.

40003255.author: पदार्थः
40003255.content: मे my, खड्गनिष्पेषनिष्पिष्टैः by those hacked off with the sword, हस्त्यश्वनरहस्तोरुशिरोभिः with trunks of elephants, horses, hands, thighs and heads of warriors, मही the earth, गहना impenetrable, दुश्चरा impassable, भविता shall become.

40003255.author: Translation
40003255.content: This entire earth will become impenetrable and impassable, scattered with the trunks, thighs and heads of elephants, horses and warriors hacked off with my sword.

40003256.author: पदार्थः
40003256.content: अद्य now, (हया: horses), मे my, खङ्गधाराहताः struck by the blows of my sword, दीप्यमानाः burning, अद्रय इव like mountains, सविद्युतः with lightning, मेघा इव like clouds, भूमौ on the earth, पतिष्यन्ति will fall down.

40003256.author: Translation
40003256.content: The elephants, struck by the blows of my sword, will fall on earth like mountains engulfed in flames and like clouds with lightning.

40003257.author: पदार्थः
40003257.content: मयि when I, बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणे while donning the godha (a leather fence fastened round the left arm to prevent injury from the bowstring) and fingerprotector (a contrivance like a thimble used by archers to protect the thumb or finger from being injured by bowstring), प्रगृहीतशरासने while holding the bow, स्थिते while I stand, पुरुषाणाम् among men, पुरुषमानी one who considers himself manly, कथम् how, स्यात् will it be.

40003257.author: Translation
40003257.content: When I stand before men (enemies) wearing godha and fingerprotector, holding the bow ready, who amongst men will boast of his manliness?

40003258.author: पदार्थः
40003258.content: अहम् I, बहुभिः with many (arrows), एकम् only one, अत्यस्यन् striking and throwing, एकेन with one arrow, बहून् जनान् (striking) many men, बाणान् arrows, नृवाजिगजमर्मसु at the vitals of men, horses and elephants, विनियोक्ष्यामि I will aim at.

40003258.author: Translation
40003258.content: Striking each of my foes with many arrows and many with one arrow, I shall aim them at the vitals of men, horses and elephants.

40003259.author: पदार्थः
40003259.content: प्रभो O Lord, अद्य today, मे my, अस्त्रप्रभावस्य of glorious weapons, प्रभावः strength, राज्ञः of the king (Dasaratha), अप्रभुताम् having no power over the kingdom, तव your, प्रभुत्वं च  supremacy over the kingdom, कर्तुम् to make, प्रभविष्यति is competent.

40003259.author: Translation
40003259.content: O Lord today you shall see the power of my glorious weapons in depriving the king (Dasaratha) of his authority and establishing your supremacy over the kingdom.

40003260.author: पदार्थः
40003260.content: राम O Rama , अद्य today, चन्दन सारस्य of sandalwood cream, केयूरामोक्षणस्य of wearing armlets, वसूनाम् of wealth, विमोक्षस्य for distributing, सुहृदाम् friends, पालनस्य for protection, अनुरूपौ worthy, इमौ these (hands), ते your, अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य obstruction to your consecration, कर्तृ़णाम् those who are causing, निवारणे in preventing, कर्म act, करिष्यतः will take up.

40003260.author: Translation
40003260.content: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecration.

40003261.author: पदार्थः
40003261.content: राम O Rama , अद्य today, चन्दन सारस्य of sandalwood cream, केयूरामोक्षणस्य of wearing armlets, वसूनाम् of wealth, विमोक्षस्य for distributing, सुहृदाम् friends, पालनस्य for protection, अनुरूपौ worthy, इमौ these (hands), ते your, अभिषेचनविघ्नस्य obstruction to your consecration, कर्तृ़णाम् those who are causing, निवारणे in preventing, कर्म act, करिष्यतः will take up.

40003261.author: Translation
40003261.content: These arms, O Rama which are fit for sandalwood cream, for wearing armlets, for distributing wealth and for protecting friends, will perform the worthy act of subduing those who are creating obstruction to your consecration.

40003262.author: पदार्थः
40003262.content: तव your, असुहृत् enemy, कः who, अद्यैव now itself, मया by me, प्राणयशस्सुहृज्जनैः with life, fame and friends, वियुज्यताम् shall be separated, ब्रवीहि you may tell me, इयम् this, वसुधा earth, यथा how, तव your, वशे under control, भवेत् shall come under, तथैव in the way, माम् me, शाधि you may command, तव your, किङ्करः servant, अस्मि I am.

40003262.author: Translation
40003262.content: Tell me your enemy who should be deprived of his life, fame and friends. Command me as to how this earth shall come under your control. Now itself I shall do that. I am your servant.
